summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings filed a Form 8-K disclosing results of its September 24, 2026 Annual Meeting and a related equity plan amendment, not a special situation. Stockholders approved increasing the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan share reserve from 25,000,000 to 50,000,000 Class A shares, while failing a charter amendment to declassify the board despite over 97% of votes cast supporting it. Turnout was 552,889,155 of 892,604,638 eligible shares. No transaction, stake, premium, advisor, or closing terms were stated. Watch governance overhang and further dilution capacity.
